description: MBPO Pedestrian Ramp Report is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. A survey of 248 street corner pedestrian ramps near accessible subway stations to determine ADA compliancy. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category Business. Its tags are ada, accessible, pedestrian ramps, curb cuts, ramp. The table has 24 columns. Attribution on the portal: Manhattan Borough President's Office. The portal shows 2021-08-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
